title: Rejected Document Type
description: The client-side accept hint on the file picker is UX only — the server is the real gatekeeper on customs document types (FR-705). Force a disallowed file through and confirm the UI turns the rejection into something readable.
successCondition: Selecting a file with a disallowed MIME type (e.g. text/plain) for upload on the Confirm step's document uploader — bypassing the picker's accept filter, e.g. via direct file input manipulation — surfaces a visible Alert with an error message after the server responds 400, and the document list does not gain a new entry for the rejected file.
hints: Browsers' native file pickers can be steered around the accept filter by setting the input's files property programmatically in your test tooling, since accept is a UX hint, not an enforced restriction.
docs/api/booking.md lists the exact allowed MIME types server-side: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png — anything else should 400.
